cand.title: CIRI–Rotman Investor Relations Certification Program
cand.organizationName: Canadian Investor Relations Institute (CIRI) and Rotman School of Management

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified, directly relevant organizer contacts: Brittany Snell, CIRI Manager, Professional Development & Marketing, is explicitly the certification-program questions contact; Sharon Doopan, Rotman Associate Director, is named on the program page. They are suitable routes to establish participant lodging needs and the welcome-package process. Neither source establishes hotel contracting authority. Do not label either a confirmed accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced 10-month hybrid cohort: April 13–15, 2027 and October 19–21, 2027 in person at Rotman School of Management, Toronto, Ontario, Canada; online sessions May–November 2027. Presentation exam November 26, 2027; mock exam December 3, 2027; final exam January 14, 2028. Exam locations/modalities are not established by the published schedule and must not be treated as hotel-demand dates. CIRI states dates are subject to change. No separate subsequent cohort through June 2028 was identified in the reviewed official publications.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is a possible optional participant/faculty lodging alternative, not the teaching venue. Its 157-room capacity is not demonstrably insufficient, but the cohort headcount, nonlocal share and peak rooms are unpublished; no 15–109-room demand assumption is justified. The university-campus teaching location does not leverage the hotel’s Harbourfront/MTCC proximity. City-hotel lodging is more relevant than a resort proposition, but campus/Bloor accommodation is a more direct location match. Meeting-space capacity is not the main constraint: teaching is already assigned to Rotman, and tuition includes breakfast, lunch and breaks on class days. Do not assume hotel catering or restaurant availability.
findings.venueCommitments: Both three-day teaching blocks are explicitly assigned to Rotman School of Management, not a hotel. Rotman Executive Programs publishes its operating address as 105 St. George Street, Toronto, Ontario M5S 3E6. This is Toronto proper at the university campus, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. The address is departmental context; a classroom/building assignment specific to this cohort is not published. This is an announced teaching-venue commitment, not evidence of an executed venue contract.
findings.historicalRotation: CIRI records the program launch with Western University’s Ivey Business School in September 2011, and the move to the Rotman partnership as of 2020. The University of Toronto lists January 28, 2020 as the Rotman certificate’s first-offered date, not a complete edition itinerary. An official September 2024 notice explicitly gives October 8, 2024 as the next session start; the 2025 chair’s report confirms delivery of the 2024–2025 cohort and nine CPIR graduates. These establish repeated delivery and an institutional partner change, not annual destination rotation. Historical physical venues, host hotels and full session dates remain unverified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027-specific lodging sourcing is unconfirmed: no published housing bureau, open RFP, contracted host hotel, room block, cutoff or room-night commitment was identified. Rotman’s general Executive Programs page states: “The hotels listed below offer a discounted rate for Rotman Executive Programs participants. Please refer to the welcome package you received for discount codes.” Every hotel listed there is Kimpton Saint George; Yorkville Royal Sonesta; Double Tree by Hilton, 108 Chestnut Street; and Chelsea Hotel Toronto. This is a general participant discount pathway, not a 2027 CIRI booking commitment or proof of reserved inventory. The CIRI FAQ’s “Accommodation Policy” concerns access to the program and does not name lodging hotels; it must not be read as housing procurement.
findings.organizationStructure: Association–university partnership: CIRI is a not-for-profit professional organization; Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto, is the academic delivery partner and published in-person venue. CIRI receives/reviews applications and publishes program administration information. No separate PCO, DMC, agency or housing contractor was identified in the reviewed program materials.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Rotman already distributes general discounted hotel options through participant welcome packages: Kimpton Saint George, Yorkville Royal Sonesta, Double Tree by Hilton at 108 Chestnut Street, and Chelsea Hotel Toronto. This is a distribution/price-access advantage, not evidence those hotels hold a CIRI room block. No sold-out inventory, overflow request, displaced room demand or competitive room allocation was found. The historical nine graduates in the 2024–2025 cohort are not the 2027 attendance or peak-room figure.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Brittany Snell and Sharon Doopan together with a short lodging-only qualification request for the two published 2027 teaching blocks. Ask for cohort size, out-of-town participants/faculty, arrival/departure pattern, who books and pays, whether hotels are already contracted, and whether an additional waterfront option can appear in the welcome package. If demand and booking access exist, propose a modest allocation or individual rate appropriate to confirmed needs, explicitly addressing travel to Rotman. Do not send a classroom/catering displacement proposal or price a speculative block. Keep this as conditional lodging/relationship development, not a qualified open local-catering opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 cohort is confirmed upcoming, but its classroom venue and included daytime meals already sit with Rotman. Hotel sourcing is unconfirmed, not open. A conditional route remains to ask about optional lodging for nonlocal students/faculty during April 13–15 and October 19–21; actual arrivals, departures, payer and booking method require confirmation. No current edition-specific lodging commitment elsewhere was verified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue an optional lodging/referral relationship with Rotman Executive Programs and CIRI rather than attempting to displace core teaching or meals. The two 2027 in-person blocks create two potential lodging windows within one cohort, not two editions. Repeated program delivery supports relationship development, but no fixed annual/biennial cadence or separate later edition is verified. Do not assume a rotating hotel venue or a future open tender.
